title: Prevent detached Git maintenance from racing sparse fixture cleanup
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The shared registered-package planner for #4848 failed after its sparse-baseline test completed, while `TemporaryDirectory` was deleting `.git/objects`: `OSError: [Errno 39] Directory not empty`. [Original run 39860907480](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39860907480/job/120111044615) ran 346 helper tests with one cleanup error and 11 platform skips. No package replay started.

Disable automatic maintenance and automatic GC only on commits creating the disposable sparse-baseline Git fixtures. Git 2.55 Trace2 records show the original helper spawning `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach`. Such a child can outlive the commit and recreate object directories while the fixture is deleted. The command-scoped settings follow existing test-fixture conventions in this repository. This changes one test file; production helpers, workflow permissions, scientific packages, frozen inputs and the selected result retain their bytes.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user-assigned upstream CI repair, based on canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`; scope unchanged. The nearest affected PR is #4848 at `890fadd4683ac206fa0c39ad58ff80932bdba26b`. #4839 and #4842 pass their own exact-head workflows. Targeted reads of all nine returned open Clear1nsight PRs show #4848 as the only failed exact-head workflow.

Current `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `autoresearch.md`, workflow and PR-intake guidance were read. The prescribed delta-only intake refresh fetched canonical main but its queue read could not run because `gh` is absent; targeted GitHub connector reads supplied the PR/workflow observations. This change makes no queue acceptance or scientific review decision.

## Validation

The new real-Git regression forces automatic maintenance to be eligible even in a tiny repository. It rejects the original commit helper because a maintenance child starts, passes with the repair, and proves its observation is active by requiring an unguarded positive-control commit to start maintenance. The positive control explicitly waits for foreground maintenance so it cannot recreate the cleanup race.

Environment: Ubuntu, Python 3.12.3, Git 2.55.0. Hosted failure environment: Ubuntu 24.04.5, Python 3.12.15, Git 2.55.0.

```sh
python3 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_baseline_sparse.py -v
python3 -W error -B -O -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_baseline_sparse.py -v
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py' -v
```

At exact fix commit `840e285b6ae0c36e5873ec63c2db7d3bb312e7dd`, normal and optimized focused suites each pass all nine tests. The full workflow helper command passes all 347 tests in 149.727 seconds with 11 expected native-Windows platform skips. An initial full local attempt omitted reference fixtures from the sparse checkout and failed; after materializing the declared fixtures, the complete command passed. That incomplete attempt is retained and is not counted as validation. The exact-head affected-package planner succeeds with `count=0` and an empty matrix, as expected for a test-only repair. No full historical or Lean suite is run; hosted validation of this repair remains pending until publication.

## Credit

Retains the existing sparse-baseline preflight and fixture work by Douglas Colkitt and lizhi, including the explicit-inventory improvements in `48aef2349dc761f6b3b6bf3e59c3ee8080dbbe7a`. CI repair by Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing licences and attribution are retained.

## Open next questions

Run the registered-package planner at the repaired upstream PR head, then its selected package replay. A passing helper test does not establish the mathematical claims or scientific acceptance of #4848.
